channel.title: Kimani Upshur Daily Devotional
channel.description: A fresh Bible devotional every day from Kimani Upshur, M.Ed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Philippians 3:13
item.description:
“Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before.”

Philippians 3:13 (KJV)

Your past does not have to steer your future. Paul chose to forget what was behind and reach for what was ahead. Let go of yesterday and stretch toward what God has next.

Prayer: Lord, help me let go of the past and reach forward today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Philippians 1:6
item.description:
“Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:”

Philippians 1:6 (KJV)

God doesn't start things He won't finish. The good work He began in you? He's completing it. Trust the process.

Prayer: Father, finish the good work You've started in me.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Proverbs 24:16
item.description:
“For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.”

Proverbs 24:16 (KJV)

Falling does not disqualify you; staying down does. The righteous are not those who never fall, but those who always get back up. Rise again today.

Prayer: Lord, when I fall, help me rise again.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Romans 8:38-39
item.description:
“For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.”

Romans 8:38-39 (KJV)

Paul lists everything that could possibly separate you from God's love, and the answer to each is: nothing. You are inseparable from His love in Christ.

Prayer: Father, persuade my heart that nothing can separate me from Your love.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Ephesians 4:29
item.description:
“Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.”

Ephesians 4:29 (KJV)

Your words are tools — they can build up or tear down. Choose words that give grace to everyone who hears them.

Prayer: Lord, set a guard over my mouth today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Ephesians 6:11
item.description:
“Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.”

Ephesians 6:11 (KJV)

You have an enemy with schemes, but you also have armor. God does not send you into battle unprotected; He outfits you completely. Put on the whole armor today, not just part of it.

Prayer: Lord, clothe me in Your full armor today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Romans 8:18
item.description:
“For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.”

Romans 8:18 (KJV)

Today's pain is real, but it's not the final word. The glory coming is so great that present suffering won't compare.

Prayer: Father, fix my eyes on the glory to be revealed in me.
